candidates.sentence: I am a pro-life Christian who will stand up for the unborn and fight for our Christian values.
I am a proud lifetime member of the NRA and will fight for all of our 2nd Amendment rights.
The American people are taxed enough and deserve leaders that will be good stewards of their money.
I will carry on President Trump’s agenda and his legacy to fight against illegal immigration and fulfill our Constitutional duty to protect our borders.
Cutting wasteful spending and downsizing government must be a top priority.
We must do this and send a strong message to those that are now flooding across those borders with no leadership from Joe Biden.
I fully support building the wall, sending illegals back to their country of origin, and fully enforcing the law on those that are in our country illegally.
